usedFor: Encharge holds people and their tags, and Google Docs gets a written record through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “Unsubscribe User” in Encharge, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Unsubscribes pile up as a readable log in one document tab, handy for list reviews.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab's existing content, so pick add or the log is overwritten.
